name: PhenoBench: Plant Phenotyping and Panoptic Segmentation Benchmark
description: PhenoBench is a high-resolution agricultural computer vision benchmark curated by the University of Bonn, the PhenoRob Cluster of Excellence, and IPB Bonn, published at CVPR 2023. The dataset comprises 2,937 high-resolution imagery samples collected over three cultivation seasons in German sugar beet fields using UAVs and ground cameras under varying natural illumination, crop growth stages, and weed infestations. PhenoBench provides hierarchical pixel-wise annotations across multiple precision agriculture tasks: plant-level semantic segmentation (soil, crop, weed), plant instance segmentation, leaf instance segmentation, and leaf counting. Users should note that while PhenoBench focuses on sugar beet fields from the University of Bonn, it is a dedicated panoptic phenotyping benchmark distinct from earlier robotic collections (Sugar Beets 2016, SB20).
